column5: The implementation of the Circular Economy Action Plan can reinforce the Farm to Fork Strategy by promoting sustainable food systems, reducing food waste, and increasing organic farming, which can aid in achieving the strategy's targets.

column2: On circularity requirements for vehicle design
column5: The On circularity requirements for vehicle design policy document can enable the Farm to Fork Strategy by promoting the use of recycled materials in vehicle design, which can help reduce waste and increase recycling rates.

The Net Zero Industry Act can reinforce the Farm to Fork Strategy by promoting sustainable food systems, reducing greenhouse gas emissions, and increasing the use of renewable energy, which can aid in achieving the strategy's targets.
